title: Give me access to my money.
text:
I am extremely disappointed with the ABSA and the Banking App and the way my FICA verification has been handled.

For several days I have been unable to access my own money because my account was apparently not FICA verified. My business has been affected and I cannot make transfers or pay my debit orders.

One of the biggest problems is ABSA’s communication. Important matters such as FICA verification should not be hidden in pop-up messages that disappear. The app constantly interrupts users with promotional and informational pop-ups, making it easy to dismiss something genuinely important when you’re busy working. Critical account issues should be communicated through a clear, permanent notification, SMS, email, or secure message that remains visible until it is resolved.

I have spent a long time on the phone with consultants, and unfortunately the service was disappointing.
